claims.evidence: The witness report confirms two road bicycles are present.
The witness saw the bicycles but did not provide a detailed assessment of cleanliness or surface condition.
Purchase history cannot be determined from photographs.
The witness explicitly noted that the functionality of brakes and shifters was not shown.
The witness noted that the condition of the chains and gear teeth was not shown.
Originality of components requires technical specifications and serial number verification not available in photos.

risks.risk: Mechanical failure of the gear system or braking mechanism.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the bicycle being ridden and shifting through all gears, followed by a hard stop.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a full drivetrain and brake system overhaul.

risks.risk: Worn out drivetrain (stretched chain or rounded cassette teeth).
risks.proof: Clear, close-up photos of the rear cassette and the chain links.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing immediate replacement of the chain and cassette.

risks.risk: Structural compromise or cracks in the frames.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all frame welds and the underside of the bottom bracket.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential frame fatigue or damage.

risks.proof: A video showing the tires being inflated and the wheels spinning freely without wobbling.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring new tires and inner tubes.

proof_requests: Video of the bicycles being operated (shifting gears and braking).
Close-up photos of the gear teeth (cassette) and chain.
Photos of the frame size stickers or measurements from the seat tube.
Clear photos of any branding or model names on the white bicycle.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the identity of the items as road bicycles. They can be priced based on a worst-case mechanical scenario for generic road bikes in the Ibadan market.
